classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Generate one compact de novo soluble protein candidate: rfdiffusion produces a small unconditional backbone (70-90 residues); ESM3 predicts structure from a seed sequence for round-trip structural validation; sequence_analysis characterises biochemical composition and motifs; protein_qc delivers lightweight pLDDT/GRAVY/pI/instability-index/polybasic scalars; rank_designs aggregates all evidence into a single scored ranked result.
assumptions: No binding target, hotspot residues, or functional context was provided; rfdiffusion runs in unconditional mode targeting a compact soluble globular fold of 70-90 residues.
params.seed_sequence defaults to human ubiquitin (76 aa), a benchmark small soluble protein; the user may substitute any sequence of comparable length to design a different candidate.
ESM3 acts as a round-trip structure predictor for the seed sequence; its confidence_scores serve as structural prediction quality evidence for rank_designs.

Because no inverse-folding tool (e.g. ProteinMPNN) is present in the selected tool set, the rfdiffusion backbone and the ESM3 sequence-based structure are treated as parallel evidence streams; rank_designs aggregates both without a binding affinity component.
Solubility is assessed indirectly via GRAVY score, pI, instability index, and polybasic-patch flags — no explicit solubility predictor is required.
rank_designs top_k is set to 1 because only one candidate design is produced in this compact workflow.
missing_inputs: No custom seed sequence supplied; workflow defaults to human ubiquitin (76 aa). Override params.seed_sequence to target a different de novo candidate.
No binding partner, hotspot residues, or partner PDB provided; binder-design mode is not activated.
